content.title: Sawiris-Backed HOF, BlueFive Discuss Buying Porsche's Bugatti Rimac Stake
content.summary: HOF Capital and BlueFive Capital are in discussions around a potential transaction involving Porsche AG (POAHY) and the venture that owns the Bugatti supercar brand, according to people familiar with the matter.  After initial talks, the two investors are exploring a possible partnership to acquire Porsche's stake in Bugatti Rimac, a joint venture between Porsche and Rimac Group, with the discussions also possibly extending to Porsche's holding in Rimac Group itself.

content.title: Tesla in top 10 brands, hybrid reliability improves: New report
content.description:
Consumer Reports released its latest automotive report card, deciding top brands and vehicles based on reliability, owner satisfaction, safety, and road tests.

Subaru (7270.T), BMW, Porsche (POAHY), Honda (HMC), and Toyota (TM) were listed as the best overall brands while Tesla (TSLA) climbed to the ninth spot for the first time.

Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian joins Market Catalysts to share takeaways from the report.

content.title: Thiel-Backed Drone Maker Triples Valuation as Ukraine War Fuels Europe's New Defense Unicorn
content.summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus.  Europe's defense-tech cycle just picked up a new momentum signal, and it's coming from Quantum Systemsa German drone maker that has quietly turned wartime demand into a 3 billion valuation.  After raising 180 million from investors including Balderton Capital, the Thiel-backed company is stepping into a different league, tripling its valuation from its prior May round.
